notes: Headline is a three-death case series, but the report also presents its own LAC surveillance case counts by year (2010–2022) and a 2022 case-fatality rate set beside a cited <1%, so data_focus is yes; limited is defensible. Lab testing only confirms case status and is not a procedure.
